JBL Go 4 - Ultra-Portable, Waterproof and Dustproof Bluetooth Speaker

$49.95
The JBL Go 4 is barely bigger than a deck of cards but somehow produces real sound — not tinny, not hollow, just solid audio that fills a dorm room. It's waterproof and dustproof, which matters when it gets knocked into a drink or left on the quad during a study break. Seven hours of battery life is enough for a full day of classes and study sessions, and it's small enough to throw in your backpack without noticing it. If you want a speaker for the dorm that won't annoy your roommate (or your RA), this is the one.
